text: The table is being set — a lesser seat, priced for what you built. They are watching to see who comes to it.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS C

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (16/12/4), 11 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
The table notes 1 ascension from one village — its terms improve accordingly. Nobody has ever seen that before.
Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
Felix is sweeping the hall. Someone has to.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Nadia is going on about Grace again. "Don't believe me? It's in the Codex. Check the board — Grace's above half the village."
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.

🍖 FEAST 📺 — Jesse opens the pantry wide: 8× Foraged food. Felix, Nadia eat until the fire burns low. Somebody laughs so hard they cry. For one evening, nobody is surviving — they're just together. (−1,600 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast
🍖 FEASTED ×2.53 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Arc IV burns hotter. Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Eulogy is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. A voice practicing your name in past tense. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE EULOGY! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.

You go down.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Jesse Mendez is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Jesse is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
🕯️ Jesse Mendez is dead — combat. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Grace blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Jesse Mendez, 145 days. The mantle passes to Grace Costa.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Grace Costa, 36 — a trail crew lead. Her hands know different work now: Patient Aim.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)
◈ THE FEARED — "Look what eating built." The footage plays unasked — the deer, the fire, the ones who came for you and didn't come back. Nobody at the table is comfortable. That is the point.
The table has read your ledger. The food truth was shared. The light road is open.
The deer. The cleanest kill. The table goes very still. Behind you, your own people go still too — a different stillness.
You let them see it. All of it. The table recalculates. The fire back home burns a little lower.
You spend it — the shield, not the sword. The small envoy stares. Your people stand a little straighter. Protective terror: the table writes it down and doesn't understand it, which is the point.
◈ THE FEARED — the last choice is yours, and it's live.
◈ THE FEARED — "Show mercy."

The most frightening thing you ever did. The table doesn't know what to do with mercy from a predator. Neither do you, quite. But the audience weeps, and the galaxy learns that the feared one chose gentleness — and that choice echoes longer than any threat. The terror stays, pled

◈ OUTSHONE — Minh Bailey did what you would not: acted, boldly, while there was still time. The village thrives. The god is someone else. The record notes, kindly and accurately, that you watched. It stings exactly as much as it should.
The terms held — the table had priced the village, ascension and all, and the village paid in full.
◈ THE OVERSIGHT —
You won. Say it plainly: you won. The village endures. The table signed. The galaxy applauds, and the applause is real, and you earned it.
And somewhere out there — past the cameras, past the light — in rows of humming glass, the little ones are still napping.
The System put a pod on the screen, and you let the segment play.
They are still there. Still small. Still waiting for someone to decide they matter more than the moment.

That is what the word means. Not the watching — anyone can watch. The oversight is the looking away. The most terrible thing the System ever did, it did by accident, because it was bored. You did it on purpose, because you were busy.
The village will tell your story for years. It will be a good story. Listen for the part they don't tell.
